answer_2.quote: For the objective evaluation, we utilize a state-of-the-art OCR model to recognize the generated samples, comparing the outputs to the ground-truth text to compute the Character Error Rate (CER) and Word Error Rate (WER) as quantitative measures of legibility.

answer_4.quote: human raters fluent in English scored the generated handwriting samples based on legibility and stylistic consistency, each on a 1-5 scale, with higher scores indicating better quality.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to score each generated sample on legibility and stylistic consistency using a 1-5 Likert scale.
